issue.title: Mobile core does not know the two bead gate kinds, so both render as 'Unsupported action'
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-gn.6 and sase-gn.8 (epic sase-gn) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs. Pre-existing gap that predates the epic; the epic only made it more visible by adding a second bead gate kind.

MobileActionKindWire in ../sase-core/crates/sase_core/src/notifications/mobile.rs has no variant for TaskTriage, and none for the BeadSnooze kind epic sase-gn added, so both classify as Unsupported and the mobile surface labels them 'Unsupported action'. The Python bridge answers both kinds fine (sase-gn.8 derived _MOBILE_GATE_ACTION_KINDS from the gate registry so BeadSnooze is at least reachable), so the core enum is the only thing that still calls them unsupported.

Second, related decision in the same file: is_priority_gate covers only PlanApproval, EpicApproval, UserQuestion, and LaunchApproval. There is no per-action priority list, so sase-gn.6 could not add BeadSnooze to the mobile priority set as its plan asked, and mirrored TaskTriage instead (Python priority.py only, no core change). Decide deliberately whether task-bead gates should be mobile-priority, and apply the same answer to both kinds rather than letting them diverge.

Scope: add TaskTriage and BeadSnooze variants to MobileActionKindWire with their labels, decide the priority question for both kinds together, and cover both in the crate's mobile tests. Cross-repo: the change lands in sase-core (open it with /sase_repo), with any Python mirror updated here.
